title: Localized maximum-norm error estimates for the Hellan-Herrmann-Johnson method
summary: We derive localized maximum-norm bounds for bending moments computed by the Hellan-Herrmann-Johnson method for the clamped Kirchhoff plate problem. The main difficulty is to localize the discrete stress without leaving the HHJ space or violating its kernel constraint. Using symmetric-curl potentials, we construct a kernel-preserving localization and connect local Green stresses with a global discrete Green stress.
